explanation: The two-job execution is faulty because Job 2 cannot preserve upstream provenance order: every priority row has upstream_rank 0 even though evidence_sources carries ranks 1 through 8. The downstream prioritize function keys ranks by evidence_sources.record_id and looks them up using coverage record_id values n06-r01..n06-r08. The supplied Job 2 input shows evidence_sources.record_id values are s01..s08, so there is no match. The visible upstream assemble_provenance source caused that mismatch by writing record_id from source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources contains records such as {"rank": 1, "record_id": "s01", "source_id": "s01"} while Job 2 needs/coverage record identities are n06-r01..n06-r08.
Observed Job 2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for all eight records despite evidence_sources ranks 1 through 8.
prioritize source builds rank_by_record_id from evidence.get('record_id') and looks up rank_by_record_id.get(coverage.get('record_id', ''), 0).
assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record_id with the source_id.
